title: When the customer pays for itself the portal works as today
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Use a shop that uses the customer portal.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, that bills itself, with contact A1, who can sign in to the customer portal.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, invoiced for $90.00, unpaid, that bills itself.
custom_steps:
1. Sign in to the customer portal as contact A1.
  2. Open work order 1's invoice.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Contact A1, customer A's contact, is signed in.

Step 2:

  • The $90.00 invoice shows with its Pay button, as today.
  • No "Billed to" line shows.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12318 (Story 16, Customer portal)
